items.exampleEn: According to the news, it will snow tonight.
items.exampleZh: 根據新聞報導，今晚會下雪。

items.exampleEn: The game was stopped because of the rain.
Can you walk a little farther? The beach is close.
items.exampleZh: 你可以再往前走遠一點嗎？海灘就快到了。

items.exampleEn: Sarah lives the farthest from the office.
Which planet is furthest from the sun?
items.exampleZh: 哪一顆行星離太陽最遠？

items.exampleEn: I had tea instead of coffee this morning.
items.exampleZh: 我今天早上喝茶，而不是咖啡。

items.exampleEn: You ought to go to bed early tonight.
I used to play the piano when I was a child.

items.sentenceEn: The train was late because of the heavy snow.

items.audioEn: Tom used to drive to work, but now he takes the train instead of driving.
items.audioZh: Tom 以前開車上班，但現在他改搭火車，不再開車。

items.sentenceEn: According to the map, the museum is near the river.
items.sentenceZh: 根據地圖，博物館在河的附近。

items.sentenceEn: We ought to leave now because of the traffic.
items.sentenceZh: 因為塞車，我們應該現在就出發。

items.stemEn: I ____ live in a small town, but now I live in a big city.
items.stemZh: 我以前住在小鎮，但現在住在大城市。

items.stemEn: Let's walk ____ taking the bus. It's a nice day.
items.stemZh: 我們走路去，不要搭公車吧，今天天氣很好。

items.passageEn: Sarah used to take a taxi to work every day. According to her bank account, she spent a lot of money on it. Because of this, she decided to ride a bike instead of taking a taxi, just like two friends from her office. Of the three of them, she lives the farthest from the office, so she has to ride farther than they do. At first it was hard, but now she enjoys it. She says everyone ought to try it.
items.passageZh: Sarah 以前每天搭計程車上班。根據她的銀行帳戶紀錄，她在這上面花了很多錢。因為這樣，她決定改騎腳踏車，不再搭計程車，就像公司裡的兩位朋友一樣。他們三個人當中，Sarah 住得離公司最遠，所以她騎車的距離比另外兩人都遠。一開始很辛苦，但現在她很喜歡騎車。她說大家都應該試試看。

questions.questionZh: Sarah 為什麼改騎腳踏車？
options: 因為搭計程車花太多錢

questions.questionZh: Sarah 現在覺得騎車上班怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 因為大雨，我們昨天留在家裡。
referenceEn: We stayed at home yesterday because of the heavy rain.
Because of the heavy rain, we stayed home yesterday.
rubricZh: because of 後面接名詞（the heavy rain），不接句子
昨天的事用過去式 stayed
例如 stay at home、stay home 等都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 used to 造一個句子，說一個你以前常做、現在不做的習慣。
referenceEn: I used to get up late, but now I get up early.
I used to drink a lot of coffee, but now I drink tea.
rubricZh: used to＋原形動詞，表示過去的習慣
可以用 but now 對比現在

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: Of all her friends, she lives the farthest from the office, so she has to ride farther than they do.：文中未交代朋友也在同一公司上班或也騎車上班，「離公司最遠」與「騎得比他們遠」的比較對象不成立
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 短文交代「兩位同公司的朋友也騎車上班」，比較改為「三人當中她住得離公司最遠，所以騎得比另外兩人遠」，中譯同步；兩道閱讀題不變、仍成立
